name: requestbench-tools
comment: The TypeScript workspace: the conformance client and the site. Each framework's error contract is a member too, at targets/<language>/<framework>/client-exception, so it is edited, built and tested where the framework lives. The client-exception subdirectory is what makes that possible: the framework's own directory never becomes a package, so targets/node stays out. It holds one resolution shared by every Node target so a difference between two of them is the framework and not a transitive bump, and pulling it in here would put this workspace's dependencies in reach of measured code.
